name: navigate_to_page
description: Navigate Jarvis to a different page. Use for home, news, calendar, home-assistant, 3d-printers, music, spiderman, manufacturing, webshooter, and round-display pages. Use 'spiderman' whenever the user asks for the Spider-Man page, the suits, or the armory. Use 'manufacturing' when the user mentions the fabrication bay, manufacturing, or building a component. Use 'webshooter' when the user mentions web shooters, web fluid, cartridges, or the web lab. NEVER use this for map or location requests — use map_command instead.

parameters.description: The page to navigate to. Use 'home' for the main screen, 'news' for the live news feed, 'calendar' for schedule/planning, 'home-assistant' for smart home, '3d-printers' for the Bambu Lab dashboard, 'music' for the full-screen music player, 'spiderman' for the Spider-Man suit armory (3D holographic suit carousel — use for any Spider-Man, suit, or armory request), 'manufacturing' for the fabrication bay (drag a component onto a printer/laser/CNC to build it), 'webshooter' for the web-shooter designer lab (taser web, web fluid, web grenade, and acid web cartridges), 'round-display' for the full-screen circular Jarvis view optimised for round displays.
